body:
I'm starting to wonder, are people getting annoyed by my army of maps? .-.
My first one(not accepted or denied yet. X3): https://avicus.net/forums/304918447?page=1
My second one(also not accepted or denied): https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/f62db8867

Anyway...

Map Name: Siege

Map Creators: CMLSC and jerbear64

Map Download: Not adding unless people like the map. :P

YAML: I'll do this if it gets accepted. 

Team Size: 20v20

Overview: The spawns are in the tower. (It's in the center.) It may not look nice, but it is set up specially so that it will be the only castle map that won't easily be won in 5 minutes. My server crashed before I could take images of the castle itself, I'll try to get them later. XD

replies.author: Clijmart
replies.body:
To be completely honest... I'm not getting annoyed by the maps, it's absolutely Awesome that you put work and effort in your work to make the server better... It's just the fact that, in my opinion, the maps aren't great.
If you want I could help you with that, add me on skype (Clijmart) and I will try to help you as good as possible <3

For this map:
Gameplay wise, this could be one of your better ones! Looks like the mons are a bit close to eachother, but you should be fine. Size of map is perfect and there's enough pvp space.. Welldone on this one dude!
Looks, not that great, but yeah, it's not needed on Avicus :P
Even though I, and a lot of others, hate badlooking maps, they still have a big chance of being accepted.
On this part I can help you a lot though, so again, if you need me, add me on skype.

Good luck with your other maps, hope you keep coming up with them so you learn from mistakes and get better at it quickly!

-Clijmart

replies.author: CMLSC
replies.body:
Part of the reason I make maps so fast is that I've already had the ideas. X3
Anyway, do you have any ideas on how to fill up the empty space on the sides of the castles?
The two monuments are in the center, while of course you can sneak around and use the ladders on the side, any smart team would remove those. The back has 4 diamond blocks and 4 horses. That was all I could think of.

Also, my plan was to put a wall with bedrock in the middle between the two monuments, but then I decided that I would put the archer level of the tower perfectly level with the monuments. :P
It would be really hard to bridge between the two monuments.

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
I am sorry to say but your map, Siege, has been denied for testing on the Avicus Network.

To Improve your map, the map developers suggest you increase the map and remove some trees. For a map like this, there should be more space in between castle and less trees for open PVP space. The map is cramped with the trees and no space to actually fight.


If you have any other questions on how to improve your map, Find me on TeamSpeak or Message me on Skype (Sethskye).


You may resubmit your map once edited.
